description: W.M.A. Perera v. People’s Bank and Another W.M.A. Perera v. People’s Bank and Another View More before Hon. S. Srikandarajah (P/CA), J.
parties: W.M.A. Perera v. People’s Bank and Another W.M.A. Perera v. People’s Bank and Another View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash an arbitral award denying him a pension after his dismissal from the 1st Respondent Bank, despite a prior High Court ruling that the dismissal was unjustified and awarding compensation in lieu of reinstatement. Held - under the bank’s Pension Rules, entitlement required an employee to be 55 years of age and possessing over 10 years of service; the Petitioner had not been reinstated and was not in service upon reaching retirement age. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
